Operating principles

Observe Improve Visualize Deliver

01 / 04

Observe & identify

Walk the floor, find what's wrong and understand its impact before proposing anything.

02 / 04

Visualize before building

Virtual images of the kitchen layout and exit boards let managers see the change before approving it.

03 / 04

Communicate formally

Concerns raised through official emails and approvals sought — CCTV, exit boards, hygiene training, drainage.

04 / 04

Support it to delivery

Follow-up and coordination until the approved improvement is implemented and monitored.

The Story

Every problem is an opportunity.

During a two-month Facility Management internship at Cyient Ltd., Noida, I went beyond routine operations — spotting concerns, visualizing fixes, getting approvals and supporting implementation. From Excel automation to drainage and kitchen layouts, the through-line stayed the same: observe closely, propose practically, and see it through.

7 Trackers & Checklists

Excel Automation

Exit Boards · Training · CCTV

Safety & Hygiene

Suggested hanging exit boards for the canteen, hygiene training for kitchen staff, and a CCTV relocation — each approved through email.

Virtual Concepts

Visual Communication

Virtual visualizations of the kitchen layout, exit boards and café renovation made every proposal easy to understand before it was built.

01 / DELIVERY · Built

Operational tracking

Seven formula-based Excel trackers and checklists.

  • DG diesel, drinking water and food waste tracking.
  • HT meter readings and facility observations.
  • NSEZ cards and weekly washroom cleaning.
02 / DELIVERY · Approved

Safety & hygiene

Practical proposals raised through formal emails.

  • Hanging exit boards for the canteen.
  • Hygiene training for kitchen staff.
  • CCTV relocation proposal.
03 / DELIVERY · Approved

Kitchen space planning

A visual proposal for a better kitchen arrangement.

  • Prepared a virtual kitchen layout visualization.
  • Shared the proposed arrangement by email.
  • Received manager approval.
04 / DELIVERY · Implemented

DG drainage improvement

A channeling proposal to address water spreading across the area.

  • Identified water spreading from an existing pipe.
  • Proposed a drainage channeling improvement.
  • Documented the implemented result with before-and-after photos.
05 / DELIVERY · Proposed

Renovation planning

A first-floor refurbishment checklist spanning ten areas.

  • Covered furniture, electrical and air conditioning.
  • Included fire safety, IT and washrooms.
  • Prepared a renovation proposal deck.
06 / DELIVERY · Visualized

Café concept design

A bare coffee area reimagined as a branded lounge.

  • Visualized seating clusters and carpet.
  • Proposed a wood-panelled counter.
  • Prepared before-and-after concept visuals.
